about_the_game:
Speed Surge is an arcade racing game where you race against time. Navigate through 24 challenging tracks, testing your skills to the limit. Are you ready to become the ultimate speedster?

In Speed Surge, players must navigate through 24 high-octane courses, The key to victory lies in finishing each track in specified amount of time. There are boost areas where speed increases and there are normal areas where your speed returns to standard. Fine-tune your skills and find the perfect balance between blazing speed and precision control to finish each race in given amount of time.

Features:

  • Arcade Racing Action: Experience the thrill of fast-paced racing with intuitive controls and exhilarating gameplay.

  • Boost Zones: Blast through specially marked regions to gain a burst of speed.

  • Diverse Tracks: Race through 24 visually stunning and challenging tracks, each designed to test your racing prowess.

  • Time Trials: Compete against the clock and set new records. If you fail to finish a track in specified amount of time, you loose.

Are you ready to become the ultimate speedster? Get ready to rev your engines and race your way to glory in Speed Surge!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 or later
  • Processor: Intel Core i3
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GT 1030
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Game works well both with controller and keyboard

  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GT 1030
